subject: EXT-F-2013-T10 opening guest Chat answer on v0.2.530

verdict_A_behavior.basis: The fresh signed-out guest sent the canonical opening request; it returned HTTP 200 and a terminal successful opening stream containing one delegated tool call. The result POST returned HTTP 200, was accepted, and reported continuation_needed=true. The observer found no correlated resume request; after the bounded 180-second answer wait, the DOM had no assistant prose and one tool-only assistant article. One unhandled rejection was recorded, with its reason and stack intentionally not retained.
verdict_A_behavior.resource_verdict: Package and browser journals are valid. Guest phase was admitted and ended child_failed with resourceInvalid=false, so the answer failure is not a resource-guard rejection.
verdict_A_behavior.scope_limit: Only the opening turn ran. Same-conversation follow-up and post-reload new conversation were not attempted.

source_diagnosis.basis: The mounted @ai-matrx/chat 0.8.178 code uses executionOrganizationForRequest for the opening send, but resumeInstance calls requireExecutionOrganizationId before preparation and again when building the body. The guest-aware helper returns no organization for a fingerprint guest; the strict helper throws when that guest has no organization. This predicts a local rejection before any /resume network request and matches the native result plus unhandled-rejection count.
source_diagnosis.fix_commit: aidream ba9205778b6805d35bd434079f0caa47d43778d2, committed 2026-10-17T19:44:56-07:00, after the native run. It changes both resume checks to the guest-aware resolver and omits organization_id when absent.
source_diagnosis.regression_test: The fix adds apps/shared/chat/src/agents/redux/execution-system/thunks/__tests__/a-guest-tool-answer-resumes-the-suspended-turn.test.ts, exercising the accepted result funnel and asserting guest and member resume behavior. This review inspected the test and source diff; it did not execute the test.
source_diagnosis.causality_limit: The native artifact did not retain the rejection reason or stack. The source cause is established by the mounted 0.8.178 code and the later targeted source fix/test, not by direct native stack evidence.
